## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the selected feature/operation and its expected output.

## Minimal reproducer

Include executable code with synthetic input, explicit features and
`errors="raise"`. For `warn`/`skip`, also include the execution report and shape.

## Environment

FEATM version; Python version; OS/architecture; installed extras;
relevant dependency versions; input shape/dtypes; CPU/GPU/Dask configuration.

## Evidence

Paste the exception/traceback or report. Do not include tokens, personal data,
model weights or large datasets. A checkpoint issue may need a redacted manifest
and the steps that created it, not a binary artifact from an untrusted source.
